an7.39:1.1: ‘‘Sattahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato sāriputto catasso paṭisambhidā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an7.39:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, sāriputto ‘idaṃ me cetaso līnatta’nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti;
an7.39:1.4: ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘ajjhattaṃ me saṃkhittaṃ citta’nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti;
an7.39:1.5: bahiddhā vikkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘bahiddhā me vikkhittaṃ citta’nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti;
an7.39:1.6: tassa viditā vedanā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti;
an7.39:1.8: vitakkā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti;
an7.39:1.9: sappāyāsappāyesu kho panassa dhammesu hīnappaṇītesu kaṇhasukkasappatibhāgesu nimittaṃ suggahitaṃ sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya.
an7.39:1.10: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, sattahi dhammehi samannāgato sāriputto catasso paṭisambhidā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī’’ti.
